chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Sa'id al-Qammat, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar al-Ju'fi, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, saying: "The faith of a servant is never complete until he possesses four traits: he ennobles his character, he makes his soul generous, he restrains the excess of his speech, and he spends the surplus of his wealth."
And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and may Allah bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his pure progeny, and grant them perfect peace.

key_terms.إيمان: Faith (iman) — complete conviction and trust in God, which in Shia theology must be accompanied by righteous action
key_terms.الفضل من قوله: Excess of speech — unnecessary or superfluous words that contribute nothing beneficial
key_terms.الفضل من ماله: Surplus of wealth — the portion beyond one's legitimate needs, to be spent in charity
key_terms.خصال: Traits or qualities — innate characteristics that can be cultivated through spiritual practice
key_terms.خلق: Character or moral disposition — the outward manifestation of one's inner spiritual state

ai.seo_question: What are the four traits needed for complete faith according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) defines the four essential traits for complete faith: noble character, generosity of soul, restraint in speech, and charitable spending. This teaching was transmitted through al-Mufaddal ibn Umar al-Ju'fi, a close companion of the Imam, and presents a holistic view of faith that integrates personal virtue, self-discipline, and social responsibility.
